units.statement: Kbar := AlgebraicClosure (ZMod p); Wbar := WittVector p (Kbar p); Fsub (m : PNat) : Subfield (Kbar p) := RingHom.eqLocusField (iterateFrobenius (Kbar p) p m) (RingHom.id _); O (m : PNat) : Subring (Wbar p) := (WittVector.map (Subfield.subtype (Fsub p m))).range; qq m := p ^ (m : Nat); relExt m d' := O p (m * d'); cyl m N g := {h | forall j i, i < N -> (h j).coeff i = (g j).coeff i}. Plus U12-supporting vocabulary (blueprint U9-U11, verbatim, NOT units): SpeciesSyntax, AlphabetData (+ attribute [instance] on its 4 bracketed class fields), AlphabetData.Stable, EQ2law.

map_comp (g : S ->+* T) (f : R ->+* S) (x : WittVector p R) : WittVector.map g (WittVector.map f x) = WittVector.map (g.comp f) x — D1's local ext lemma (Mathlib lacks WittVector.map_comp); 3 lines via WittVector.ext + map_coeff
Fsub_le {d m : PNat} (h : d dvd m) : Fsub p d <= Fsub p m
O_le {d m : PNat} (h : d dvd m) : O p d <= O p m

relExt_eq (m d' : PNat) : relExt p m d' = O p (m * d') [rfl]; relExt_relExt (m d' d'' : PNat) : relExt p (m * d') d'' = relExt p m (d' * d'') [unfold; mul_assoc]; O_le_relExt (m d' : PNat) : O p m <= relExt p m d' [O_le p <d', rfl>] — PROVED (blueprint's inline proofs; O_le_relExt via U3's O_le)
qq_mul (m d' : PNat) : qq p (m * d') = qq p m ^ (d' : Nat) — betaarg_eq half EXCLUDED (deviation 1)
Fsub_card (m : PNat) : Nat.card (Fsub p m) = p ^ (m : Nat)

EQ2law_card {Sp} (AD : AlphabetData p Sp) (h : EQ2law p AD) : forall (delta : PNat) (x : AD.Pos), AlphabetData.Stable p AD delta x -> Nat.card (AD.alpha delta x) = qq p delta ^ AD.aDim 1 x AND Nat.card (AD.alpha delta x) = Nat.card (AD.alpha 1 x) ^ (delta : Nat)
O_chain (m drel d'' : PNat) : O p m <= O p (m * drel) AND O p (m * drel) <= O p (m * drel * d'') — Setting-free restatement (deviation 2)
